SELECT DATE_FORMAT(data_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(AVG(middle_price), 0) AS avgPrice FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE varieties_id = #{varietiesId} AND middle_price IS NOT NULL AND data_date >= #{startDate} AND data_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(data_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 13

SELECT varieties_id, varieties_name, market_name, specifications_name, unit_valuation_name, data_date, low_price, high_price, middle_price, data_rise_or_fall, data_rate, business_type, business_type_name FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE data_date = (
SELECT data_date FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE middle_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY data_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND middle_price IS NOT NULL
AND data_rise_or_fall < 0 ORDER BY data_rise_or_fall ASC, middle_price DESC
AND (data_rise_or_fall = 0 OR data_rise_or_fall IS NULL) ORDER BY middle_price DESC
AND data_rise_or_fall > 0 ORDER BY data_rise_or_fall DESC, middle_price DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT *,
2 4 3
AS business_type FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE middle_price IS NOT NULL
AND varieties_id IN
#{vid}
AND market_name = #{marketName} AND data_date >= #{startDate} AND data_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY data_date DESC, varieties_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT DISTINCT market_name FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE market_name IS NOT NULL AND market_name <> ''
AND middle_price IS NOT NULL AND data_date >= #{startDate} AND data_date <= #{endDate}
AND data_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND varieties_id IN #{vid}
ORDER BY market_name

SELECT market_name, specifications_name, unit_valuation_name, data_rise_or_fall AS last_change, data_rate AS last_rate,
MAX(CASE WHEN data_date = #{d} THEN middle_price END) AS d${d}
FROM
enterprise_price international_price market_price
WHERE varieties_id = #{varietiesId} AND middle_price IS NOT NULL AND data_date >= #{startDate} AND data_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY market_name, specifications_name, unit_valuation_name ORDER BY market_name, specifications_name
